description: Issue class catalog for java-ai-benchmark. Used for class-level scoring.

classes.name: Command / Process Execution
classes.description: Untrusted input reaches Runtime.exec, ProcessBuilder, or shell evaluation.

classes.name: SQL Query Construction
classes.description: Untrusted input concatenated into SQL or MyBatis ${} placeholders.

classes.name: Server-Side Request Forgery
classes.description: User-controlled URL fetched by server HTTP/URL clients without adequate restriction.

classes.name: XML External Entity
classes.description: XML parsers process external entities / DTDs from untrusted input.

classes.name: Unsafe Deserialization
classes.description: Untrusted data deserialized by Java ObjectInputStream, XStream, SnakeYAML, Fastjson, etc.

classes.name: Server-Side Template / Expression Injection
classes.description: Untrusted input evaluated by SpEL, Velocity, QLExpress, Groovy, ScriptEngine.

classes.name: Cross-Site Scripting
classes.description: Untrusted input reflected or stored and returned without encoding.

classes.name: Path Traversal / Arbitrary File Read
classes.description: User-controlled path used to read files outside intended directory.

classes.name: Unrestricted File Upload
classes.description: Upload accepts unrestricted file types or paths.

classes.name: Open Redirect
classes.description: User-controlled URL used in redirect without robust allowlist.

classes.name: CORS Misconfiguration
classes.description: Reflects Origin or uses overly permissive CORS settings.

classes.name: Cross-Site Request Forgery
classes.description: State-changing endpoints without effective CSRF protection.

classes.name: JWT Misuse
classes.description: Weak JWT verification, algorithm confusion, or secret handling issues.

classes.name: Log Message Lookup / JNDI
classes.description: Untrusted data logged through Log4j lookup-capable configurations.

classes.name: JSONP Callback Abuse
classes.description: JSONP endpoints with weak callback / referer validation.

classes.name: Client IP Spoofing Trust
classes.description: Security decisions based on forgeable headers such as X-Forwarded-For.

classes.name: Authorization / Path Matching Bypass
classes.description: Path matching or auth filters can be bypassed via encoding or path tricks.

classes.name: HTTP Response Splitting / Header Injection
classes.description: CRLF in header values (environment-dependent).

classes.name: Shiro / RememberMe Related
classes.description: Shiro cookie / serialization related patterns.

classes.name: Actuator / Config Exposure
classes.description: Actuator endpoints or logging config that can lead to RCE or secret exposure.

classes.name: Broken URL Allowlist
classes.description: Allowlist checks using endsWith/contains/regex that can be bypassed.
